Change c0523. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. VII; 1831 Ch. XXIV.

Context before (unchanged): They looked at one another, and were unable to reply.

1818 text: I spoke; I told them to retire, and consider of what had been said: that I would not lead them further north, if they strenuously desired the contrary; but that I hoped that, with reflection, their courage would return.

1831 text: I spoke; I told them to retire, and consider of what had been said: that I would not lead them farther north, if they strenuously desired the contrary; but that I hoped that, with reflection, their courage would return.

Diff: I spoke; I told them to retire, and consider of what had been said: that I would not lead them [-further-] {+farther+} north, if they strenuously desired the contrary; but that I hoped that, with reflection, their courage would return.

Context after (unchanged): They retired, and I turned towards my friend; but he was sunk in languor, and almost deprived of life.

result.rationale: Only 'further' becomes 'farther' in 'lead them further north'; the same sense of distance is kept, so this is a comma-level word choice with no interpretive consequence.
